bsm_enabled.description: If enabled, receives and forwards of BSM on multicast enabled interfaces. BSM is a protocol by which the device learns RPs dynamically.

dr_priority.description: The probability of a PIM interface elected as a Designated Router (DR). For Static RP, the DR Priority advertised in a PIM Hello is 1.

id.description: The ID of the multicast config.

igmp_protocol_parameters.description: The Internet group management protocol (IGMP) version the routers regularly send queries to determine which groups are active/inactive in an appropriate LAN segment.

last_member_query_count.description: The number of times the ION device sent IGMP queries to the last known active host on the subnet. Default value is 3 secs.

last_member_query_interval.description: The time interval for the ION device to respond to the IGMP query from the last known active host on the subnet. Default value is 1 sec.

query_interval.description: The time interval between successive IGMP queries. Default value is 125 secs.

query_max_response_time.description: The maximum response time to the IGMP query. Default value is 100 secs.

igmp_protocol_parameters.title: MulticastIgmpProtocolConfig

hello_hold_time.description: The time interval which a neighbor waits for a Hello message from a sender neighbor before pruning the neighbor. Default value is 105 secs.

hello_interval.description: The time interval between two PIM Hello packets. Default value is 30 secs.

join_prune_interval.description: The time interval between two Join/Prune messages sent to a neighbor. Default value is 60 secs.

spt_switchover_enabled.description: Indicates that the first multicast packet is received i.e. the source address is received by the receiver, the DR at the receiverâ€™s end and the RP choose the optimal path to relay information from the source to the receiver.
